reviews.text: Beautiful colour and superb longevity. You forget you’re even wearing it as it feels so light and natural on your lips but the colour will last for many hours even when eating food or drinking.
reviews.zh: 顏色靚，持久力一流。感覺輕盈又自然，唔講都唔覺自己搽咗，但個色維持到好多個鐘，食嘢飲嘢都仲喺度。

reviews.text:
The lock's design is adorable and can be hung on a bag as a pendant (but be careful not to come loose if you bump into it).
It can dye its lips, so it maintains color quite well, with a very, very beautiful luster.
reviews.zh:
鎖嘅設計好得意，可以掛喺袋上面當吊飾(不過要小心撞到會甩)。
會上色，所以顏色keep得好好，光澤亦都非常非常靚。

reviews.text: The glow lock jelly tint is one of my favorite lip products, I found the shade petal randomly at TJMaxx, which purchases overstock products, I mainly bought it because it was cute and realized how much I loved the shade and formula after. When applying it feels very light but the gloss lasts well and the tint is very pretty. The gloss is sheer, but also a little buildable, I would like it to be slightly more pigmented but otherwise I love it, if I find a matching lip liner it might help. I ordered the shade heavy, which I am wearing in the photo included because I had no purple shades of lip products I loved, and when I tried it on I thought it was so flattering, thought it could have been a little cooler toned. I am saving the unopened box to try when I get back to school and wear daily makeup.
reviews.zh: glow lock jelly tint 係我最鍾意嘅唇部產品之一，我喺 TJMaxx 隨便撞到 petal 呢隻色，TJMaxx 係賣過季貨嘅鋪頭，買嘅時候主要係覺得佢得意，用完先發覺自己幾咁鍾意呢隻色同質地。搽上嘴感覺好輕身，但唇彩keep得耐，染色效果都好靚。唇彩好通透，不過都有少少疊加得色嘅空間，希望可以再顯色少少就好，除咗呢點之外我好鍾意，如果搵到配襯嘅唇筆可能會幫到手。我另外訂咗 heavy 呢隻色，就係我喺相入面用緊嗰隻，因為我未有一隻鍾意嘅紫色唇部產品，一試上嘴就覺得好顯氣質，不過覺得可以再冷調少少。未開盒嗰支我留咗等返學再試再日常化妝用。

reviews.text: Caramel is definitely my favorite shade!! I basically got it because I mean Beomgyu uses it lol. But this shade is just really perfection. It smells sooo good and even tastes good. The shade is so perfect and it is very long lasting. The packaging was sooo cute and really convenient to use. You can also put the lock on your bag and use it as an accessory it’s soo adorable. It’s very smooth as well! And doesn’t leave your lips dry
reviews.zh: Caramel 絕對係我最鍾意嘅色號!!基本上係因為 Beomgyu 用緊所以我就買咗 lol。但呢隻色真係完美。聞落超香，連食落味道都唔錯。色號好完美，而且好持久。包裝超可愛，用落都好方便。可以將個鎖掛喺袋上當飾物，超得意。質地都好滑！而且唔會令到嘴唇乾燥。

reviews.text:
Okay, to be honest, I only bought this because of Beomgyu of TXT hehe but the formula surprised me so much! I think my dry lips actually look as juicy as Beomgyu’s after using this jelly tint. 

The color is very wearable for daily use. But you can also build it up for more intense pigment. The container is very cute and unique but did have to figure out how to hold the shape for my top lips.
reviews.zh:
好啦，老實講我買呢支完全係因為 TXT 嘅 Beomgyu hehe，不過質地真係出乎意料！我覺得我嘅乾唇用完呢支 jelly tint 之後真係睇落同 Beomgyu 嘅一樣 juicy。

顏色好日常好實著。但都可以疊加出更濃郁嘅顯色。容器好得意又特別，不過都要摸索下點樣掌握個形去畫上唇。

reviews.text: I saw the ads about Beomgyu from TXT with this jelly tint, so I immediately bought it. And it is really pretty in actual. The design is great, the jelly tint makes my lips so glow. And also it is easy to carry around by link on my pants belt spot. So I really like it. I always love to be my lips shine and this is the one ✨️💕
reviews.zh: 我睇到 TXT 嘅 Beomgyu 拍呢支 jelly tint 嘅廣告，所以即刻買咗。實物真係好靚。設計好正，jelly tint 令我嘅嘴唇好有光澤。而且可以扣喺褲頭位好方便攜帶。所以我真係好鍾意。我一向鍾意嘴唇有光澤，呢支就啱晒 ✨️💕

reviews.text: I sometimes wants to look mature. So I bought caramel because it looks kinda dark or something like that, I cannot explain well. But it is really cool, I got really glow lips after I apply it and my lips was shine and moisturize my lips. And the smell is really good...it's really like jelly, it is jelly tint. ✨️🩷
reviews.zh: 我有時想睇落成熟啲。所以我買咗 caramel，睇落有少少深色咁嘅感覺，我又講唔清。但真係好正，搽完之後嘴唇好有水光感，嘴唇變得亮同有保濕。而且味道真係好好...真係好似 jelly，佢就係 jelly tint。✨️🩷

reviews.text: I found out about this tint because of Beomgyu and also took the color 102 which is one of his pick. I didn't expect that this color would suit me so much! I really like it! and the design is very unique and cute! And also it smells good. The size is a little smaller than I expected. I will definitely buy more
reviews.zh: 我係因為 Beomgyu 先識到呢隻 tint，亦揀咗佢揀過嘅 102 號色。冇諗過呢隻色咁啱我！真係好鍾意！而且設計好特別好得意！仲有好香。Size 就比我想像中細少少。一定會再回購。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
